title: feat(circular-economy): implement Enterprise Circular Economy Lifecycle Studio Suite (#931)
head: dipanshubatra:feature/enterprise-circular-economy-lifecycle-studio
body:
## 📝 Description
Implements Enterprise Circular Economy Lifecycle Studio Suite for eco-buddy-ai, providing product lifecycle assessment (LCA), Ellen MacArthur Foundation style Material Circularity Index (MCI) scoring, and Scope 3 landfill diversion telemetry.

Key highlights:
- Engine service (`circular_economy_engine.py`) with MCI math, component breakdowns, and audit profile registry.
- Created Streamlit interface (`pages/Circular_Economy_Studio.py`) with interactive KPI metrics, product catalog, and registration modal.
- Created React dashboard component (`src/components/circular/CircularEconomyStudioView.tsx`).
- Added pytest unit test suite (`test_circular_economy_engine.py`) - All 3 tests passed cleanly.

## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #931
